definitions.explanation: Animals raised on farms for food, labor, or other products, such as cattle, pigs, sheep, goats, and chickens.

{家畜|かちく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝染病|でんせんびょう}→伝染病：29731_densenbyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
